popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias' Argive succession — Triopas son of Phorbas as king of Argos, father of Iasus and Agenor, ancestor in the line that leads to Io.

popCulture.title: Io (mythology)
popCulture.description: The Argive heroine's stemma runs back through Triopas' house — the king who sits in Pausanias' native king-list before the Io generation.

popCulture.title: Triopas of Argos
popCulture.description: Argive king, son of Phorbas — distinct from Triopas the Heliad of Rhodes and from Poseidon's Thessalian son.
